guide_extractions.document_match_reason: The document is Baylor's 2026 Game 5 notes for its Oct. 3 road game against Arizona State in Tempe.

recent_game.fact: Baylor defeated Colorado 23-13 on Sept. 26 to improve to 3-1 overall and 1-0 in Big 12 play.
Baylor held Colorado to 363 total yards, forced eight punts in 15 drives, recovered a fumble and made two fourth-down stops.
Baylor recorded five sacks and 13 tackles for loss against Colorado; the 13 TFLs were its most in a game since 2019.
Linebacker Travion Barnes led Baylor against Colorado with a Baylor career-high nine tackles and two tackles for loss.
Baylor has won three consecutive games entering the Arizona State matchup.

opponent_notes.fact: Arizona State enters the matchup 2-1 after wins over Morgan State and Kansas and a 48-20 loss at No. 9 Texas A&M.
Arizona State most recently defeated Kansas 24-17 in London after building a 24-7 lead entering the fourth quarter.
Arizona State quarterback Cutter Boley, a sophomore transfer from Kentucky, has nine touchdown passes, two interceptions and averages 245.3 passing yards per game.
Against FBS opponents, Boley is 32-of-57 for three touchdowns and two interceptions and averages 174.5 passing yards per game.
Arizona State receiver Reed Harris has 19 catches for 374 yards and five touchdowns, while Omarion Miller has 20 catches for 149 yards.
Arizona State running back Kyson Brown has 43 carries for 227 yards and one touchdown.
Arizona State defenders Owen Long and Martell Hughes have 25 and 21 tackles, respectively; Long has an interception and Hughes has 3.5 tackles for loss.

Former Baylor outside linebacker Emar'rion Winston joined Arizona State in 2026 and is playing defensive line; he started all 12 games for Baylor in 2025 and recorded 25 tackles, 5.5 tackles for loss and three sacks.

quarterback.fact: Florida transfer DJ Lagway is Baylor's starting quarterback after making 19 starts over two seasons for the Gators.
Lagway threw two touchdown passes in Baylor's most recent win over Colorado.
Lagway threw for 333 yards and two touchdowns against Auburn before a lower-leg injury caused him to miss time.
Nate Bennett started against Prairie View A&M in place of the injured Lagway and completed 24 of 36 passes for 314 yards and three touchdowns while adding a rushing touchdown.
Bennett also played against Louisiana Tech and completed 21 of 24 passes for 253 yards, accounting for three passing touchdowns and one rushing touchdown.

offensive_personnel.fact: Baylor added 16 offensive transfers for 2026, including quarterback DJ Lagway, wide receivers Gavin Freeman and DeBraun Hampton, tight end Tony Livingston and several offensive linemen.
Baylor had first-time team starters DJ Lagway, Dawson Pendergrass, Louis Brown IV, Gavin Freeman, Nate Kibble, Asher Hale and Logan Moore on offense against Auburn.
Gavin Freeman has 35 catches for 364 yards through four games, averaging 8.75 receptions and 91 receiving yards per game.
Jayden McGowan has four receiving touchdowns and averages 24.13 yards per catch through four games.
Baylor replaced its five leading pass catchers from the 2025 offense, including NFL departures Josh Cameron and tight end Michael Trigg.
Starting tight end Matthew Klopfenstein is a Scottsdale native and attended Horizon High School in Arizona.
Baylor returned running back Dawson Pendergrass after he missed the 2025 season with a preseason season-ending injury.
Baylor entered 2026 with a running-back rotation led by Pendergrass, Caden Knighten and Michael Turner, with freshman Ryelan Morris also receiving carries.
Baylor had to replace four offensive-line starters for 2026; returning right tackle Kaden Sieracki started all 12 games in 2025, played 948 snaps and did not allow a sack.
Baylor's opening offensive line included first-time Baylor starters Nate Kibble at left guard, Asher Hale at right guard and Logan Moore at right tackle.
Center Harrison Cluff made his first Baylor start against Prairie View A&M, and tackle Cooper Lovelace made his first Baylor start against Louisiana Tech.

defensive_personnel.fact: Baylor added 21 defensive transfers for 2026, with major investments on the defensive line, at edge rusher and at safety.
Baylor's portal additions included interior defensive linemen Hosea Wheeler, Kameren Washington, Jamaal Whyce Jr. and Traevon Mitchell, plus edge rushers Ryan Davis and Garrick Ponder.
Baylor added Kansas State defenders Ryan Davis, Daniel Cobbs and Colby McCalister, all of whom previously played in coordinator Joe Klanderman's system.
Oklahoma transfer Devon Jordan has emerged in Baylor's cornerback rotation opposite returning starter LeVar Thornton and has two interceptions through four games.
Bo Onu leads Baylor with three sacks through four games.
Traevon Mitchell made his first collegiate start at defensive tackle in Baylor's win over Colorado.

coaching_changes.fact: Dave Aranda stopped calling Baylor's defense after the 2025 season and hired former Kansas State coordinator Joe Klanderman as defensive coordinator and safeties coach.
Klanderman coordinated Kansas State's defense from 2020-25, and his units ranked in the top 30 nationally in defensive efficiency in each of his final five seasons.
Jake Spavital is in his third season as Baylor's offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach.
Austin Woods is in his first full season as Baylor's offensive-line coach after serving as interim offensive-line coach for the final five games of 2025.
Baylor hired Jacori Greer as defensive-line coach and Jeremy Modkins as cornerbacks coach for 2026.

injury_availability.fact: DJ Lagway suffered a lower-leg injury in the season opener against Auburn but returned and threw two touchdowns in Baylor's Week 4 win over Colorado.
Safety Jacob Redding and wide receiver Ashton Jones have season-ending injuries for 2026.
Starting defensive tackle Devonte Tezino suffered a season-ending injury on the first drive against Prairie View A&M.
Running back Dawson Pendergrass returned to full speed for 2026 after missing the entire 2025 season.

offensive_context.fact: Baylor averages 29.8 points and 435.8 total yards per game, including 285 passing yards and 150.8 rushing yards.
Baylor ranks 25th nationally in passing offense at 285 yards per game and 11th in first downs with 103.
Baylor has produced at least 300 total yards and 200 passing yards in each of its first four games.
Baylor has allowed 1.5 sacks per game but 7.25 tackles for loss per game through four contests.
Arizona State allows 285.7 total yards per game, including 161.3 passing yards and 124.3 rushing yards.

defensive_context.fact: Baylor has held four consecutive opponents below 20 points, its longest such streak since 2005.
Baylor allows 13 points and 306 total yards per game, including 97 rushing yards and 209 passing yards.
Baylor ranks fourth nationally with 3.75 sacks per game and fifth with nine tackles for loss per game.
Baylor ranks 10th nationally in fourth-down defense, 12th in red-zone defense, 13th in passing-efficiency defense and 16th in scoring defense.
Arizona State averages 38 points and 426 total yards per game, including 260.3 passing yards and 165.7 rushing yards.
Excluding its 70-7 win over Morgan State, Arizona State averages 22 points and 298.5 total yards per game against FBS opponents.

special_teams.fact: Against Colorado, punter Palmer Williams averaged 50.4 yards on seven punts, with four punts of at least 50 yards and four downed inside the 20.
Jayden McGowan returned seven punts for 130 yards against Colorado, including a long return of 36 yards.
Rhett Armstrong made three field goals against Colorado, including a 54-yarder, and also converted attempts from 37 and 27 yards.
Baylor ranks 10th nationally in net punting at 44.79 yards and has blocked one punt and one kick this season.
Armstrong became Baylor's placekicker after Connor Hawkins transferred to Ohio State following the 2025 season.

series_context.fact: Arizona State leads the series 2-0, winning 34-13 in Tempe in 1990 and 27-24 in Waco in 2025.
In the 2025 meeting, Arizona State made a 43-yard field goal as time expired to defeat Baylor 27-24.
Baylor tied the 2025 meeting with 1:52 remaining before Arizona State drove 49 yards in 11 plays for the winning field goal.

other_relevant.fact: The Arizona State game is Baylor's first true road game of the 2026 season; Baylor entered the week with a three-game road losing streak.
Baylor added a program-record 39 transfer-portal players for 2026 and has 58 returning players.
A Baylor win would produce the program's first 2-0 conference start and first 4-1 overall start since 2021.
